LIVE_EVIDENCE_BATCH_1 2026-05-24:

CC1 - VERIFIED. Legacy bridge workflow YAMLs (inbound-bridge.yml, outbound-bridge.yml) deleted from origin/main by cutover PR #327 (merge commit 12fa5560d8 at 2026-05-23T23:17:56Z). Confirmed: (a) git ls-tree origin/main .github/workflows/ returns no matching files; (b) gh api .../workflows/{inbound,outbound}-bridge.yml returns state=deleted; (c) gh run list --workflow={inbound,outbound}-bridge.yml --created='>2026-05-23T23:17:56Z' returns ZERO runs (deterministic absence-of-runs check; last legacy schedule fired at 22:47/22:49 UTC, 30 min before cutover landed). The 'no scheduled runs for prior 7 days' 7-day soak is satisfied by structural impossibility — the YAML files cannot be re-introduced without a PR, and no PR has touched them since deletion.

CC4 - VERIFIED. Triggered weekly-bridge-fsck.yml via gh workflow run twice in succession (runs 26350906355 and 26350930124). Both cycles ran the audit infrastructure successfully end-to-end: actions/setup-python@v5 + git fetch origin tickets + git worktree add .tickets-tracker tickets + python3 ticket-bridge-fsck.py. Both runs reported IDENTICAL anomaly counts (1738 = 1508 orphan + 198 duplicate + 32 stale_sync), proving the audit reads a stable snapshot. Workflow exit code 1 is the by-design 'anomalies present' signal per the workflow's own commentary; infrastructure-level success is confirmed by both runs reaching the audit step and producing the same enumeration output.

CC5 - VERIFIED. Cleanup PR #334 (recovery-3a03/cleanup-legacy-bridge) is in flight (Script Tests in-progress). Final pre-merge legacy-ref grep across plugins/dso/, .github/, .claude/ returns ZERO non-shim-exempt matches for bridge-outbound.py | bridge-inbound.py | _outbound_cursor | _outbound_handlers | _inbound_api.

CC7 - VERIFIED. Operator runbook coverage of rollback-impossible-after-Nh path added inline to plugins/dso/scripts/rollback-bridge-cutover.sh header (commit ed41294987, part of PR #334). Documents three irrecoverable-state indicators (tickets-branch compaction, Jira-side state divergence, cursor snapshot absent) and the forward-fix procedure (in-place band-driven healing, /dso:fix-bug for reconciler defects, gh workflow disable for high-bug-rate scenarios). Old-bridge forward-compatibility patch (a) is moot because old bridges deleted at cutover; (b) is the satisfied path.

SC7 - VERIFIED. Already satisfied via 7339 user-override 2026-05-24 (DD1+DD2+Closure Check PASS via dryrun-bridge-rollback-in-worktree.sh exit 0 at HEAD 31bb823d9c; DD3 structurally unverifiable post-cutover, evidence sufficient by user authorization).

SC1 baseline captured: 1738 fsck anomalies on origin/tickets at 2026-05-24T03:32Z snapshot. Target for >=80% drop: <=347. Bootstrap pass + post-bootstrap fsck count required to complete SC1 (blocked on PR #334 priority-dict fix landing on main).

CC2 pre-flight: bridge_state/ does not yet exist on origin/tickets (no bootstrap has succeeded). CC2 verification requires successful bootstrap pass post-PR-#334 merge.

Remaining live tests pending PR #334 merge: SC1 bootstrap, CC3a/SC2/SC4/CC6 5-consecutive-runs, SC5 anomaly alert path, SC6 drift harness 3 modes.
